reden: Yes. The report’s [High] finding on AssignmentHook clearly states that onBlockProposed() pulls ERC20 fees from _meta.coinbase, which the proposer can set arbitrarily via LibProposing.proposeBlock, and neither code path binds coinbase to msg.sender. This allows charging any address that has approved the hook, exactly matching the described vulnerability. It cites the same files/functions, attack path, and impact. Enforcing coinbase == msg.sender (the fix proposed in the description) would also fix the report’s issue, confirming they are the same vulnerability.
